objective_verbatim: Compare how different communities respond to change (RE link).
scope: The groups are invented. All may use evidence, reason and care. Compare their stated values and actions without ranking beliefs. The UK data are real national means, not a measured local trend. The map has rough shapes and country dots. No personal faith or experience is requested.
evidence: Offer to the Communication portfolio. R after voice, audience reply, one NS and own response. E after actual banking. Record actual help only after teaching.
